parts.label: (b)
parts.stem:
$\mathbf{A}$ and $\mathbf{B}$ are structural isomers with molecular formula $\text{C}_5\text{H}_{10}\text{O}$.

They are both straight-chained molecules with only one functional group.

Table 5.1 describes observations when separate samples of $\mathbf{A}$ and $\mathbf{B}$ are added to different reagents.
parts.text:
Table 5.1

| reagent | $\mathbf{A}$ | $\mathbf{B}$ |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazine (2,4-DNPH reagent) | orange precipitate appears | orange precipitate appears |
| Tollens' reagent | silver mirror appears | no reaction |
| alkaline $\text{I}_2\text{(aq)}$ | no reaction | no reaction |

parts.label: (c)
parts.stem:
$\mathbf{C}$ is a structural isomer of $\mathbf{A}$ and $\mathbf{B}$.

$\mathbf{C}$ is straight chained and has two functional groups.

$\mathbf{C}$ shows only one type of stereoisomerism.

Table 5.2 describes observations when separate samples of $\mathbf{C}$ are added to different reagents.
parts.text:
Table 5.2

| reagent | $\mathbf{C}$ |
| :--- | :--- |
| 2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazine (2,4-DNPH reagent) | no reaction |
| $\text{Br}_2\text{(aq)}$ | orange to colourless |
| alkaline $\text{I}_2\text{(aq)}$ | yellow precipitate appears |
